types.name: Court decision
types.description: A decision issued by a court: a judgment (ítélet), a partial or interim judgment, or an order (végzés), usually anonymised, with the court's heading, the parties, the reasoning and the ruling. Case numbers such as 27.P.20.093/2020/13 identify it.

keys.description: Name of the court that issued THIS decision, exactly as written: the court named in the document's heading and in its signature line. Do NOT use a court that is only mentioned in the text as an earlier, lower or higher instance.
The date on which this decision was issued (the date of the judgment, usually in the signature line at the end).

The kind of court document. judgment = a final decision on the merits (ítélet); partial_judgment = a decision on part of the claims (részítélet); interim_judgment = a preliminary decision on a point of principle (közbenső ítélet); order = a procedural or non-merits decision (végzés); other = anything else. The kind is normally stated in the document's heading in capital letters (for example ÍTÉLETET, RÉSZÍTÉLETET, KÖZBENSŐ ÍTÉLETET, VÉGZÉST): decide by that heading, not by words elsewhere in the text.

Every identifier this document states for ITSELF in its own text, exactly as written, one value per distinct written form: the case number (ügyszám, normally after 'Az ügy száma:'), the decision's own number (after 'Az ítélet száma:' or 'A határozat száma:', and the number printed in the page header or title), and any other number the document gives as its own. The case number and the decision's number can differ (by a sequence number, a suffix such as -III or -ítélet, or a part such as a roman numeral), and both must be stored when the document states both. Do NOT include the number of another case that the text only mentions (a first-instance or earlier case, a cited decision). Filter with eq or in for one known number, or contains for a part (for example a case-type prefix).

What the lawsuit is about, as the document itself words it: the short phrase after 'A per tárgya:' in the heading, or the phrase before 'iránt indított perében' ('... ellen <subject> iránt indított perében'). Copy that phrase in the document's language (for example 'tulajdonjog megállapítása'); do not translate, shorten or classify it. Omit the key if the heading does not state a subject.

The kind of property lawsuit, classified into a closed list. co_ownership_dissolution = the claim is to end a co-ownership of a thing (közös tulajdon megszüntetése), by buy-out, auction or division. ownership_declaration = the claim is a declaration of ownership (tulajdonjog megállapítása), for example by adverse possession (elbirtoklás) or by building on another's land (ráépítés). ownership_declaration_and_co_ownership_dissolution = the claims include BOTH. marital_property_division = the claim is to divide the property of spouses or cohabitants (házastársi vagy élettársi vagyonközösség megosztása, házassági vagyonjogi per). fx_loan_contract = the claim is about a loan or credit contract in a foreign currency or tied to an exchange rate (deviza alapú kölcsön, svájci frank): its invalidity, unfair terms, or the consequences; it takes precedence over contract_validity and payment_claim. contract_validity = the claim is about whether a contract is valid, in force, in existence or void (szerződés érvénytelensége, hatálytalansága, semmissége, létre nem jötte), including a sale of land or a gift; not a foreign-currency loan. payment_claim = the claim is to be paid money owed under a contract or a debt (loan repayment, purchase price, rent, the price of work, a contractual penalty) when the validity of the contract is not the main issue. damages = compensation for harm (kártérítés), including harm caused by a crime or by a public authority or a court (közhatalom gyakorlásával, bírósági jogkörben okozott kár); not the protection of personality rights. personality_rights = protection of personality rights: violation of honour, dignity, privacy, image or bodily integrity (sérelemdíj, vagyoni elégtétel), press correction (sajtó-helyreigazítás), public-interest data. inheritance = wills and estates (végrendelet érvénytelensége, hagyaték, kötelesrész, öröklési szerződés). company_law = decisions of company organs, member rights, the liability of officers, claims arising from liquidation (társasági vagy taggyűlési határozat, vezető felelőssége, cstv.). expropriation = a challenge to an administrative decision in an expropriation procedure (kisajátítás), its compensation or the expert fee fixed in it. land_registry_admin = a challenge to a land registry decision (ingatlan-nyilvántartási ügyben hozott határozat vagy végzés). other_admin_review = any other judicial review of an administrative decision (building, land transactions, tax, immigration, compensation for restrictions) that is not expropriation or land registry. other = anything else, including family, labour, intellectual property and enforcement matters, and orders that decide no claim. If a case fits several values, take the one that names the claim the ruling decides. Decide by what the plaintiff claims and the court rules on, not only by the heading's label: if the heading says declaration of ownership but the claim and the ruling end a co-ownership by auction or buy-out, it is co_ownership_dissolution. Quote the sentence that states the claim or the ruling.

How the lawsuit ended for the PLAINTIFF, decided from the ruling (the operative part after the heading, which starts with a sentence like 'A bíróság ... elutasítja / megállapítja / megszünteti / kötelezi'), not from the reasoning. granted = the claim was upheld in full (for a co-ownership dissolution: the court ended the co-ownership as claimed, by buy-out or auction; in a case where the plaintiff challenges an authority's decision: the court annulled or set aside the decision, usually ordering a new procedure). partly_granted = upheld in part and dismissed for the rest ('ezt meghaladóan elutasítja'). dismissed = the claim was dismissed (keresetét elutasítja). partial_or_interim = the document is a partial judgment (részítélet) or an interim judgment (közbenső ítélet) that does not finally end the case. procedural_end = the proceedings ended without a decision on the claim (withdrawal, termination, transfer); an annulment of an authority's decision is NOT this, it is granted. For a decision on an APPEAL (the court speaks of the first-instance judgment: 'helybenhagyja', 'megváltoztatja', 'hatályon kívül helyezi'), do not use granted, partly_granted or dismissed; use judgment_upheld = the first-instance judgment was left in force (helybenhagyja), judgment_changed = it was changed in whole or in part (megváltoztatja, részben megváltoztatja), judgment_annulled = it was set aside and the case sent back (hatályon kívül helyezi, új eljárásra utasítja). These three values are ONLY for a court that decides an appeal against another court's judgment or order. A court that reviews an AUTHORITY's decision for the first time (a közigazgatási per, for example about an expropriation) and annuls it ('megsemmisíti', ordering a new procedure) has upheld the claim: that is granted, never judgment_annulled. other = none of these. Read the WHOLE ruling before choosing: a sentence such as 'ezt meghaladóan' or 'egyebekben ... elutasítja' means the claim succeeded only in part, and a sentence about costs (perköltség) or fees (illeték) never decides the outcome. Quote the ruling sentence that shows it.
